items.title: Konitz Lee — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...gave a lot of good writers their break like Holman or Lenny Niehaus, or Rugolo, or Graettinger... [INTERVIEWEE] I had some kids by then... I was with that band for about a year and a half...

ctx.x: Yeah, and a lot of other people. Shorty Rogers . . .
Yeah. All those guys wrote charts but apparently he lost his shirt on it. It was just too big of a band to support even if the music was popular.
